composition.label: Composition
composition.blurb: Shape and count of the output.

outpaint.label: Outpaint
outpaint.blurb: Extend the canvas or zoom out.

mostly-dead.label: partial
mostly-dead.hint: parses fine but only a couple of models act on it as a hard rule

unimplemented.label: reserved
unimplemented.hint: the parser recognizes it but explicitly errors — reserved for future work

parameters.name: ar
parameters.desc: Aspect ratio of the output. Accepts `w:h` or one of the named aliases.

parameters.name: output-count
parameters.desc: How many variations to return. Type the number directly — `--1`, `--2`, `--3`, or `--4`.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.desc: Freeze the RNG. Same seed + same prompt + same model = same image. Some models may ignore it.

parameters.name: transparent
parameters.desc: Hard filter: only models that produce a native transparent (alpha) result are considered. Combines with model triggers; if the intersection is empty you get a clear error.

parameters.name: sref
parameters.desc: Style reference. Pass one or more image URLs; each can carry a per-URL weight via `::N`.

parameters.name: sw
parameters.desc: Global style-reference weight. Applies to whatever `--sref` URLs are set.

parameters.name: cref
parameters.desc: Character reference URL. Reserved — the parser accepts it but explicitly errors "not yet implemented" so it never silently no-ops.

parameters.name: cw
parameters.desc: Character-reference weight. Reserved alongside `--cref`.

parameters.name: no
parameters.desc: Negative prompt — the things you don't want. Only a few of our models honor it as a hard exclusion; on the rest it becomes a hint that biases the prompt enhancer. The engine does NOT narrow the model pool when `--no` is present, so which behavior you get depends on which model the selector picks.

parameters.name: png
parameters.desc: Force PNG output.

parameters.name: jpg
parameters.desc: Force JPEG output.

parameters.name: webp
parameters.desc: Force WebP output. Falls back to PNG on providers that can’t emit WebP.

parameters.name: svg
parameters.desc: Force vector SVG output. Only picked when a vector-capable model can service the prompt.

parameters.name: 2k
parameters.desc: High-resolution image tier (~2048 px on the long side). Costs more credits.

parameters.name: 4k
parameters.desc: Ultra-high-resolution image tier (~4096 px on the long side). Costs more credits.

parameters.name: upscale
parameters.desc: Upscale an input image (the `upscale_2x` operation).

parameters.name: vary
parameters.desc: Create a variation of an image (the `vary_strong` operation).

parameters.name: varysubtle
parameters.desc: Subtle variation of an image.

parameters.name: varystrong
parameters.desc: Strong variation of an image.

parameters.name: panleft
parameters.desc: Extend the canvas to the left. Append a companion `--<amount>` flag (fraction, e.g. `--0.5`, or pixels, e.g. `--512px`) to control how far.

parameters.name: panright
parameters.desc: Extend the canvas to the right. Companion `--<amount>` flag controls how far.

parameters.name: panup
parameters.desc: Extend the canvas upward. Companion `--<amount>` flag controls how far.

parameters.name: pandown
parameters.desc: Extend the canvas downward. Companion `--<amount>` flag controls how far.

parameters.name: zoomout
parameters.desc: Zoom out 1.5×. Original stays in place; new content fills the border.

parameters.name: zoomout2x
parameters.desc: Zoom out 2×. Same idea as `--zoomout` but wider border.
parameters.note: Under development — the underlying `zoom_out_2x` operation is in the engine's DISABLED_OPERATIONS set; calls today will not run. Use `--zoomout` (1.5×) for now.

parameters.name: zoomoutexpand
parameters.desc: Zoom-out variant that expands the composition rather than just adding border.
parameters.note: Under development — the underlying `zoom_out_expand_1_5x` operation is in the engine's DISABLED_OPERATIONS set; calls today will not run.

parameters.name: zoomoutexpand2x
parameters.desc: Expand-out variant at 2×.
parameters.note: Under development — the underlying `zoom_out_expand_2x` operation is in the engine's DISABLED_OPERATIONS set; calls today will not run.

parameters.name: mp4
parameters.desc: Trigger video generation. Becomes img2vid if input images are present, otherwise txt2vid.

parameters.name: video-resolution
parameters.desc: Video resolution. Type the value directly — `--480p`, `--720p`, `--1080p`, etc. 4k is requested with `--2160p` or `--4k` (also `--4k60fps`) and is Seedance 2 Pro only — pair with `--seedance2pro` or `--flagship`. Note: `--4k` means the 4K *image* tier on image prompts, and 4k video on `--mp4` prompts. Frame-rate suffix (`p24`, `p30fps`) is also accepted; Seedance renders 24fps.

parameters.name: video-fps
parameters.desc: Frame rate. 24 and 30 are the safest across providers; higher rates depend on the selected model.

parameters.name: video-duration
parameters.desc: Clip length. Accepts either the short `--5s` or the long `--5sec` form.

parameters.name: flagship
parameters.desc: Force the flagship (highest-quality) model of whatever operation you're running. Works universally.

parameters.name: sora
parameters.desc: Force OpenAI Sora 2 Pro (video).
compat: Only one model trigger per prompt.

parameters.name: soralite
parameters.desc: Force OpenAI Sora Lite (video). Cheaper than Sora Pro.

parameters.name: nanobananapro
parameters.desc: Force Google Nano-Banana Pro. Works for both txt2img and img2img — the router picks the variant by input.

parameters.name: nb2
parameters.desc: Force Google Nano-Banana 2 for txt2img / img2img.

parameters.name: gpt2
parameters.desc: Force OpenAI GPT-image-2 (medium quality) for txt2img / img2img.

parameters.name: gpt2high
parameters.desc: Force GPT-image-2 (High quality). Slower + more expensive than `--gpt2`.

parameters.name: seedance2
parameters.desc: Force Seedance 2 Fast (video). Works for txt2vid / img2vid / ref2vid.

parameters.name: seedance2pro
parameters.desc: Force Seedance 2 Pro (video). Works for txt2vid / img2vid / ref2vid.

parameters.name: demo
parameters.desc: Signed-in-only: access seeded demo generations without spending real credits.
